title: drymocallis glandulosa var. viscida
intro: Drymocallis glandulosa var. viscida, commonly known as sticky cinquefoil, is a plant species in the rose family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to treat inflammation, wounds, and skin conditions due to its antiseptic and astringent properties. The plant is known to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. Bioactive constituents of sticky cinquefoil include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
